question: An astronaut's hip loses about 1.5% of its bone a month. A six-month mission equals how many years of 1%-a-year ageing?
move: Check the time unit on a rate before calling it small.
trap: Hearing 1.5% as small without noticing it is per month.
hint: Work out the total lost in orbit, then divide by the yearly rate.
steps: 1.5% a month x 6 months = 9% lost in orbit.
Ageing on Earth takes about 1% a year.

items.label: A year of ageing on Earth

diagram.caption: Six months in orbit take as much hip bone as nine years of ageing.
